About Linda's Seafood

Linda's Seafood, located at 13008 Market St, Houston, TX 77015, is a hidden gem for seafood lovers looking for fresh and flavorful dishes. Despite its humble appearance, the restaurant offers an authentic seafood experience that stands out in the local dining scene. Known for its unpretentious yet excellent food, Linda's Seafood delivers dishes that are loved by both first-time visitors and regulars alike.

The menu at Linda’s Seafood is simple but packed with flavor, offering an array of seafood dishes that cater to all tastes. From fried shrimp to fish tacos, each plate is prepared with fresh ingredients that highlight the natural taste of the seafood. While the restaurant does have a slight fishy smell, a common trait in seafood establishments, this is easily overlooked once the delicious dishes arrive at the table. It’s clear that the quality of the food far outweighs any initial concerns.

For those new to the area or visiting for the first time, Linda’s Seafood offers more than just great food. The atmosphere is casual and welcoming, with plenty of seating for those dining in. Though many patrons opt for takeout, there’s no problem enjoying a meal in the cozy, no-frills setting. The staff are friendly and attentive, adding to the warm and inviting experience. It’s not uncommon for the owner to send guests off with a cheerful farewell, making the visit even more memorable.

Linda’s Seafood deserves recognition for both the quality of its dishes and its commitment to customer satisfaction. The food presentation is impressive, and the freshness of each ingredient is undeniable. Whether you're a local or just passing through, Linda's Seafood is a place that guarantees satisfaction with every bite. The restaurant’s friendly service, fresh seafood, and simple yet delicious menu make it a must-try for seafood enthusiasts.

Reviews

“ Originally from this area and never knew about this place. I was doing some calls in the area, and had been craving seafood. As I pulled up, I realized I forgot my wallet, and was panicking, only to find they accept Apple Pay. This place deserves continual recognition for how good the food is and even the presentation on the plate. My pictures don’t do it justice. The food was fresh. I highly recommend and will be coming back. Most people order to pickup, though I ate there with no issue, plenty of seating. As I left the lady was very kind and happily yells goodbye to everyone. It’s one of those places you do t judge by it’s look. ”

Angel Ortiz

“ The food is unpretentious. The food is excellent. If you didn't enjoy Linda's seafood, you don't understand it. ”

Luke S.

“ The absolute truest definition of hole in the wall. Now I put 5 stars for service & atmosphere because sometimes those low key rude and dingy spots have the best food. When i walked in and the floor sticky I knew my food was about to be fire and it did not disappoint. I got the Whole Flounder Fried Hard...thank me later. ”

Brandon Scott

“ This is a hidden Houston gem if you're looking for a good generous amount of tasty fried fish with a side of fries for a reasonable price! They also have good seafood soup and boiled shrimp here. Overall customer service friendly and quick service! It's worth the drive, you won't be disappointed! ”

Patrick

“ Nice people. Keep in mind this is a seafood restaurant. It does have a slight fishy smell, but the food is excellent! ”

SIGN COMMANDERS

“ My family has been going to the ever since they open and we love their food, the lady that is always there, always welcomes me. A hole in the wall. ”

Daniela Martinez

“ Very Good fish and shrimp will recommend them to family and friends ”

Tonnette Carter

“ My Favorite Seafood, There Staff is professional with time and quality of foods. The prices area the main reason, there consistent no matter the economy fluctuates that we often see that affect prices. ”

Breanna Bookman

Linda's Seafood

Linda's Seafood in Houston, TX offers a variety of seafood dishes for lunch and dinner, with options for takeaway, dine-in, and delivery. From Jalapeno Peppers to medium Boiled Shrimp, Seafood Soup to Fish Soup, and Fish Po Boys to Shrimp Po Boys, there's something for every seafood lover. With wheelchair-accessible facilities, a family-friendly atmosphere, and convenient parking options, Linda's Seafood is a must-visit spot for fresh and delicious seafood. Call +1 713-330-3838 to make a reservation or order online.
